t: Extra thick, heavyweight natural rubber gauntlets with long cuff for added protection to the lower arm. Anatomically shaped to ensure comfort, flexibility and to reduce hand fatigue during prolonged periods of use. Chlorinated for low extractable proteins and residual chemicals. Rolled cuff offers drip protection, increased glove strength when donning and helps reduce roll-down. A naturally smooth, flock-free inner allows easy donning and removal.
b: Anatomically Shaped to Reduce Hand Fatigue
